$about: UK tax year figures the calculators use, 2026/27. Copied into dist/ by npm run build (scripts/data.js). For a new tax year, add data/<year>.json and point the @data marker in src/lg-calc.js at it. Amounts in pounds a year; rates as fractions.
$checked: 29 October 2026: Scottish Income Tax bands (GOV.UK) and student loan thresholds and rates (Student Loans Company terms for 2026 to 2027) confirmed. 30 October 2026: LTT main and higher residential rates (Welsh Revenue Authority, Land Transaction Tax rates and bands, updated 10 December 2024) and LBTT residential rates and first-time buyer relief (Revenue Scotland, Residential property, revised 28 August 2026) confirmed; SDLT bands, and the 2% non-resident surcharge from £40,000 on top of all other rates (GOV.UK, Rates of Stamp Duty Land Tax for non-UK residents, updated 1 April 2025), confirmed. Still to confirm on the official pages: the SDLT first-time buyer relief and 5% surcharge (GOV.UK) and the 8% Additional Dwelling Supplement (Revenue Scotland).

mortgageAffordability.$about: How much lenders could offer, as income multiples. Typical market ranges, not any lender's figures: check them every few months. Lenders count income after a year of committed spending; credit card balances count as a monthly payment of cardPayment of the balance; bonus, overtime and commission count at variableIncome. exampleRate is only the starting value of the rate field.

redundancy.$source: Statutory redundancy pay for dismissals from 6 April 2026: the weekly pay cap from the Employment Rights (Increase of Limits) Order 2026 (Great Britain), and nidirect's Redundancy pay page for Northern Ireland (£783, confirmed 30 October 2026).

propertyTax.$about: Tax on buying a home, for individuals buying a whole residential property. These rates change at Budgets, not only in April: check them whenever a UK, Scottish or Welsh Budget is announced. Each band is a slice of the price; upTo null is the top slice. Surcharges don't apply below surchargeFrom.

sdlt.$source: GOV.UK: Stamp Duty Land Tax residential rates for England and Northern Ireland, from 1 April 2025

lbtt.$source: Revenue Scotland: Land and Buildings Transaction Tax residential rates, first-time buyer relief, and the Additional Dwelling Supplement (8% from 5 December 2024)

ltt.$source: Welsh Revenue Authority: Land Transaction Tax main residential rates (from 10 October 2022) and higher residential rates (from 11 December 2024)
